tips: A little tip: your bank will never ask you for a code over the phone.

facts: Did you know? Your bank will never ask you for a code over the phone. If someone does, it's a scam.
Did you know? Couriers don't charge customs fees by text. A payment link in an SMS is a warning sign.
Did you know? A familiar voice can be copied with artificial intelligence. That's why a family word is so useful.
Did you know? Nobody genuine will ask you to install AnyDesk or TeamViewer. If they do, hang up.
Did you know? Rushing you is a scammer's favourite trick. If you're in a hurry, stop and ask.
Did you know? The tax office never asks for your card details by text.
Did you know? A message saying your account closes today is trying to scare you. Real banks give you time.
Did you know? You can always hang up. It's never rude to call back on the number you already have.
Did you know? Gift cards are for presents. Nobody genuine asks you to pay a bill with them.

quiz.text: Your parcel is on hold due to an unpaid £1.99 fee. Pay today here: {royalmail-redeliver.top/pay}
quiz.clue: Royal Mail doesn't ask for fees by text with a link. If you're expecting a parcel, check the official website yourself.

quiz.text: We've blocked your card after a suspicious payment. Verify your details at: {customer-security.app}
quiz.clue: Your bank never asks for details through a link. Call the number on the back of your card.

quiz.text: Hi, it's me, I've broken my phone and this is my new number. Can you send me some money urgently? I'll explain later.
quiz.clue: A new number, a rush and money: a classic trap. Call their usual number first.

quiz.text: Sorry, I sent you a 6-digit code by mistake. Could you send it back to me? It's urgent.
quiz.clue: A code is like your front door key: never give it to anyone.

quiz.text: Congratulations! You've won a new phone. Claim it within 24 hours: {prize-club.win}
quiz.clue: Nobody gives away surprise prizes, especially in a rush. They want your details.

quiz.text: “Your computer has a virus. Install this app so we can fix it for you remotely.”
quiz.clue: No real technician calls you to install anything. It's fine to hang up.

quiz.text: You are due a tax refund of £312.40. Confirm your bank account at: {tax-refund-uk.com}
quiz.clue: HMRC doesn't ask for your bank details by text. If in doubt, go to the official website yourself.

quiz.text: Notice: your power will be cut off today for an unpaid bill. Avoid it by paying now: {energy-payments.net}
quiz.clue: Scaring you with a cut-off today is a trick. Call the number on your bill yourself.

quiz.text: Invest £250 today and make £3,000 in a week with our system. Limited places!
quiz.clue: Nobody can promise that much money that fast. If it sounds too good, it's a trap.

quiz.text: Your vehicle tax payment failed. Pay today to avoid a fine: {dvla-renew.info}
quiz.clue: The DVLA doesn't chase payments by text with a strange link. Use the official website.

quiz.text: Your prescription is ready to collect. We're open from 9:30 to 8pm.
quiz.clue: It doesn't ask for money, details or taps. It just lets you know.

quiz.text: Reminder: your appointment is tomorrow at 10:15 with your GP. If you can't come, please call the surgery.
quiz.clue: A reminder: no payment, no details, and it tells you to call them yourself.

quiz.text: Hi, I'll be there at 8 for dinner. Shall I bring bread?
quiz.clue: A contact you already have, asking for no money or codes. Enjoy dinner!

quiz.text: Card purchase of £23.50 at Sun Supermarket with your card ending 4821.
quiz.clue: It just tells you about a purchase. If it wasn't you, call the number on your card.

quiz.text: I've left your umbrella in the letterbox. Thanks for lending it to me!
quiz.clue: A neighbour you know, no rush and no payments. All fine.

quiz.text: Your parcel will arrive tomorrow between 9am and 2pm. You don't need to do anything.
quiz.clue: It informs you without asking for payment or taps. That's how real companies write.

quiz.text: We've seen an unusual payment on your card. Call our security team now on 01632 960 815.
quiz.clue: A number to call written in the message goes to the scammers. Call only the one on the back of your card.

quiz.text: Hi, I'm interested in your sofa. I've paid through the safe payment service: check your email and accept it so the money reaches you.
quiz.clue: A buyer never pays through a page they send you. If nothing came into your bank, there's nothing to accept.

quiz.text: My love, I'm stuck at the airport and they won't let me fly to you without a £300 fee. Can you send it today?
quiz.clue: Someone you've never met in person who asks for money is always a trap, however sweet the words.

quiz.text: A new phone has signed in to your banking app. If it was you, you don't need to do anything.
quiz.clue: It asks for nothing and has no link. If it wasn't you, call the number on the back of your card.
